newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Guoco buys 40 pct of Zeus Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Guoco buys 40 pct of Zeus Holdings.

text.p: Guoco Holdings (Philippines) Inc has bought 40 percent of holding firm Zeus Holdings Inc, Zeus said on Tuesday.

Zeus told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Guoco had signed a sale agreement with Eagle Cement Corp and Far East Cement Corp, two major owners of Zeus, to buy 40 percent of Zeus' outstanding share capital.
Zeus and Guoco officials were not available to give details of the buy-in.
Zeus used to be a garment company before it was restructured into a holding company last year.
Guoco has interest in real estate development and soft drinks manufacturing. Guoco is the local unit of Hong Kong's Guoco Group Ltd.
